content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause stating "Transfer of title with respect to any Product shall be subject to full payment and settlement of all claims Cremer may have against Ultragenyx in connection with the execution of this Agreement.", ownership and title to the Product should pass to the Client upon full payment of the applicable invoice. - Regarding the clause stating "Cremer's liability arising from this Agreement is limited to intentional misconduct or gross negligence.", except for liability arising from gross negligence or willful misconduct, the Contractor's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client under this Agreement. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards.
